description: This file defines the DurationDependency class, which manages duration calculations and date manipulations for start and end date fields in a CRM module, including UI updates and event handling.

classes.name: DurationDependency
classes.description: A class that handles duration calculations, date parsing, and UI updates for start/end date fields in a CRM module.

methods.name: calculate_duration
methods.description: Calculates the duration in seconds between start and end date fields.

methods.name: change_start
methods.description: Updates the end date based on a change in the start date and the current duration.

methods.name: change_duration
methods.description: Updates the end date when the duration is changed.

methods.name: update_duration_fields
methods.description: Updates hidden input fields for hours and minutes based on the current duration.

methods.name: get_duration_text
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the duration.

methods.name: set_duration_handler
methods.description: Sets the duration value in the UI element.

methods.name: add_custom_duration
methods.description: Adds a custom duration option to the duration select element.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object based on the specified format.

methods.name: set_date
methods.description: Sets the date fields in the UI based on a Date object.
